# Mental Health Strategy

This folder contains the high-level political strategies and clinical guidelines that shape the structural approach to ADHD care in Denmark. It documents the 10-Year Plan, a major political initiative aimed at reversing negative trends in psychiatric treatment through increased resources, alongside the DMPG guidelines that standardize ADHD assessments for children and adolescents in hospital and specialist settings. Together, these pages trace how national policy mobilization and specific clinical frameworks drive quality improvements, cross-sectoral coordination, and data registration practices across the healthcare system.

## Pages

- [[10-aars-planen|10 års planen]] — A Danish political strategy designed to improve ADHD care and reverse negative trends in psychiatric treatment through increased resource allocation and cross-systemic collaboration.
- [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG-retningslinje]] — A topic page for the DMPG guidelines that currently serves as a structural placeholder without extracted claims or relationships.
- [[dmpg-retningslinjen-udredning-af-adhd-hos-boern-og-unge-i-hospitalsregi-og-speciallaegepraksis|"DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis"]] — A 2025 clinical guideline document that standardizes ADHD assessments for younger populations and directly shapes national quality indicators and registry data practices.
